front: Which expands most: solids, liquids or gases?
back: Gases most, then liquids, then solids.

front: Why does a solid expand when heated?
back: Its particles vibrate more and move slightly further apart (they do not grow).
Two different metals joined together; it bends when heated because they expand differently.

front: Give three uses of thermal expansion.
back: Thermometers, bimetallic thermostats, shrink-fitting metal rings or tyres.

front: Give three problems caused by expansion.
back: Buckling rails and bridges, sagging power lines, cracked glass.

front: Why do bridges have expansion joints?
back: To let the bridge expand and contract with temperature without damage.
